competitors.name: Walmart
competitors.action: Walmart is extending value messaging into back-to-school grocery, keeping its lunch basket under $2 per lunch, adding a grocery-focused college basket under $35, and running more than 1,300 additional rollbacks versus last year. The signal for Real Dough is that mass retail is anchoring seasonal traffic with explicit food-value bundles, raising pressure on premium freezer brands to show affordable-meal logic, not only quality cues.

competitors.name: Instacart / Arpalus
competitors.action: Instacart acquired Arpalus, an AI shelf-scanning startup whose computer-vision system lets workers record store-level product availability by smartphone and identifies items with 95% average accuracy. For Real Dough, the retailer-facing signal is that digital shelf accuracy and in-stock visibility are becoming more measurable at item level, making operational reliability a larger part of the freezer sales story.

competitors.name: General Mills
competitors.action: General Mills said it is increasing innovation and renovation across major North America Retail brands after fiscal 2026 net sales fell 5% to $18.42B and NAR sales dropped 11% to $10.57B. Management called out protein, fiber, clean label, bold flavors and fun/indulgent products as priority demand spaces, while noting Totino's was one of two businesses that drove outsized fiscal-year pressure.

trends.magnitude: Walmart lunch basket under $2 per lunch; college grocery basket under $35; 1,300+ more rollbacks than last year
trends.context: Mass retailers are using food baskets and rollbacks to pull seasonal trips, which can make premium frozen products work harder to justify price within family and student meal planning.

trends.magnitude: Arpalus system identifies shelf items with 95% average accuracy; Instacart workers visit large-format retail locations more than 15 times per day on average
trends.context: As grocery platforms connect shelf scanning, fulfillment data and smart-cart imagery, out-of-stock and availability performance may become more visible to retailers and suppliers.

trends.magnitude: General Mills cited protein, fiber, clean label, bold flavors and indulgence as demand spaces worth hundreds of billions in retail sales
trends.context: Large CPG players are rebuilding growth plans around benefit-led and experience-led product claims, including in meal and snack adjacencies that influence freezer expectations.
